integrity: All integers in the mathematically proven upper-bound range are included; prime certificates come from deterministic trial-factor sieve. Reproducibility is provided by an attached standalone script. The review is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite extremal classification for heights 2 through 23 only; neither further records nor their distribution are determined. Earlier unindexed computations could overlap the numerical cutoff.
title: The first composite maximal odd height for modified Dedekind \(\psi\) iteration
